sources.snippet: Overview qwen-image-edit-plus-lora is an image editing model created by qwen that specializes in precise image modification guided by text instructions. The model uses Qwen2.5-VL for semantic understanding combined with a VAE encoder for visual fidelity preservation, enabling edits that maintain both the meaning and visual quality of the original image.
